## Summary

Pinned cleat builds and Rust cache uploads dominate CI time. Cache the old/new cleat binary directory with its provenance and an input-sensitive key, retain Rust cache restores while saving only on main, and fix Windows-only warnings with proper Unix gates.

```diff
-cleat: clone and build both pinned revisions on every run
+cleat: restore binaries and provenance; build only on an exact cache miss
-rust-cache: save after pull-request jobs
+rust-cache: restore on PRs, save on main
```

The applied operator workflow diff also makes every Windows compile fail on warnings, adds a Windows GNU cross-target check to the existing Linux clippy job, and upgrades checkout from Node 20's v4 to v7. The selector runner, its tests, documentation and selector file are restored unchanged from the requested base. The structural selector/crate redesign is deferred to #2909 per the owner's scope amendment.

Closes #2907

## Evidence

Baseline: [CI run 37690879953](https://github.com/flotilla-org/flotilla/actions/runs/37690879953).

| Baseline job/step | Duration |
|---|---:|
| Windows whole job | 24m20s |
| Windows Rust setup / cache restore | 20s / 26s |
| Windows clippy / binary build / TUI check | 69s / 130s / 60s |
| Windows selected tests / cache save | 777s / 367s |
| Cleat whole job | 12m00s |
| Cleat pinned builds / core contract compile+run | 283s / 406s |
| macOS whole job / selected step | 19m09s / 1111s |

The earlier [PR run 37695124576](https://github.com/flotilla-org/flotilla/actions/runs/37695124576) measured Windows 11m31s, cleat 10m52s and macOS 7m07s, but used the now-removed runner redesign and unapplied workflow proposal; those numbers do not describe this final change. The requested base already removed shared selectors present in the older baseline. Final timings are being collected from CI run 37766618087 at operator commit 6dc4f00da; cache-hit state will be reported explicitly.

Local validation: platform/script contracts, Git boundary check and tests, cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, and cargo test --workspace --locked with default TMPDIR. Cache-key inputs include pinned source/toolchain/preparation scripts, architecture and hosted runner image; changing image identity changes the key.

The Linux cross-target check installs MinGW for ring's build script. Its CI result is recorded with the final full run.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way; revert the cache key and workflow settings.

**Blast Radius:** CI. Cache misses rebuild the pinned tools; cache hits retain provenance. The real cleat contract remains separate because its feature needs both provisioned binaries. Its workspace-inclusive Rust cache reuses the feature-specific core test executable.

## Resource schema changes

No resource schema change.

## CI coverage

No selector lines or new jobs. Existing selector execution is unchanged. The Windows cross-target check runs in the existing Linux clippy job.
